note: The accepted residue of the recoverability invariant's widest rung (scripts/elision-monotone.ts --strict, 160 columns). Each entry is a document that still loses content at that width, with the columns it would need. The baseline MAY ONLY SHRINK: a document that no longer loses content must be dropped, and a new one fails the gate. Reshaping these is an authoring call, not a renderer one — both are embedded payloads whose code lines run past 200 characters, and a code fence has no cap, so widening repairs them.
